name: bank-multi
inspiration: Composite: The DAO reentrancy + Parity-style unprotected admin

known_bugs.description: External ETH transfer precedes the balance update, enabling a reentrant receiver to drain all deposits.
setAdmin() has no authorization, so any account can seize admin and sweep() the entire balance.
sweep() does not validate `to`, and transfer to the zero address does not revert, so the entire balance can be permanently burned while depositors' recorded claims survive.
